raw_text: A video purportedly showing a fresh crackdown on protesters in Srinagar went viral on social media on Saturday. Fact-checking organisations Alt News and BoomLive have confirmed the footage dates from the 2016 unrest following the killing of Hizbul Mujahideen commander Burhan Wani. Jammu and Kashmir Police spokesperson said no such incident occurred and the situation in Srinagar remained peaceful throughout the day. The video was shared by multiple Pakistan-based accounts simultaneously, suggesting a coordinated disinformation campaign.
clean_text: India Today reports viral Srinagar crackdown video confirmed as 2016 footage by fact-checkers. J&K Police confirm no incident occurred. Video shared simultaneously by multiple Pakistan-based accounts suggesting coordinated disinformation.
